plugins.name: nodge
plugins.description: Connects this session to your Nodge platform: project, pipeline, deploy, logs and monitoring tools over MCP, plus commit-context capture — plans, decisions and progress are recorded per commit so any agent can recover the why behind a change from git history. Includes /nodge-connect (sign in + git auth), /nodge-clone (clone a project by slug), /nodge-doctor (diagnose the connection) and /nodge-about (what's in the box).
